about_the_game:
You play Ava, a would-be adventurer whose guild registration becomes the first step into something far more dangerous. The threat exists on the road ahead and deep beneath her own skin.

Every choice is emotionally charged. Some open new paths. Others open wounds. All of them shape who Ava becomes and what she learns to carry forward.

About The Quiet After

The Quiet After is the official visual novel from Grigsby's World Productions, a psychological, choice-driven narrative about memory, identity, desire, and consequence. Written and directed by Marshall Short, the game explores intimacy, trauma, and the tension between autonomy and influence through branching paths and multiple endings.

Your decisions reflect your psychological approach to love and loss. The story can lead toward romance, desire, and freedom, or into darker territory, examining harm, consent, and control.

Features

  • Branching story arcs examining intimacy, trauma, and self-reflection

  • Emotional choice tracking that unlocks new narrative paths

  • Multiple endings and optional scenes exploring growth, desire, and recovery

  • Handcrafted art and atmospheric audio

  • Mature storytelling driven by character decisions

Content Advisory

This game includes themes of trauma, psychological tension, coercion, intimate situations, and violence. Player discretion is advised.

Official Information

The Quiet After is an original IP created by Grigsby's World Productions, LLC. Written and directed by Marshall Short. USPTO Serial No. 99265844.

content_descriptors.notes: Psychological horror exploring consent, and complicity through player choices. Contains sexual content, trauma themes, partial nudity, violence, and gore.
